activity_summary: After The Comedy of Errors, Heminges said you had not one line of your own in Egeon. Pope said a sigh would have been an extra line. You left the part as it was set. The comedy is still at Field's. The jig is Thursday.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Counted the part clean, and sent you home.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Named the sigh you did not add.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the old man as he was set.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Not one line of your own, Will
